items.title: Atlassian results seen as ’game changer’ for AI kills software worries
items.summary: The results carry implications well beyond Atlassian itself. Enterprise software stocks have been among the year’s hardest-hit groups on fears that AI would displace traditional collaboration and productivity tools, and TEAM’s print is now being read as a sector-wide inflection point, potentially benefiting direct peers such as Datadog (NASDAQ: DDOG) and Snowflake (NASDAQ: SNOW), both cited by analysts as comparable re-rating candidates.
